results.title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
results.summary: The foundational production paper (serving platform for Kimi) that separates prefill and decoding clusters around a disaggregated KVCache, transferring KV state between pools while exploiting underutilized CPU/DRAM/SSD and reporting up to 525% throughput gains.

results.title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized LLM Serving
results.summary: The seminal academic paper that popularized prefill/decode disaggregation, formally modeling the inter-phase interference and proposing to place prefill and decode on independent GPU pools with KV cache handoff to optimize goodput under latency SLOs.

results.title: Disaggregated Inference: 18 Months Later
results.summary: A field report by the original DistServe designers surveying how disaggregated inference moved from research to production, and adoption across NVIDIA Dynamo, vLLM, and SGLang, plus future directions like attention-FFN disaggregation.

results.title: FlowKV: A Disaggregated Inference Framework with Low-Latency KV Cache Transfer and Load-Aware Scheduling
results.summary: Directly targets the KV cache transfer communication bottleneck between prefill and decode nodes, reducing average transmission latency by 96% (0.944s to 0.053s) via a load-aware scheduler that supports flexible, heterogeneous node allocation.

results.title: Prefill-as-a-Service: KVCache of Next-Generation Models Could Go Cross-Datacenter
results.summary: Argues PD disaggregation is now the standard architecture but remains constrained by KVCache transfer over the network; proposes selectively offloading long-context prefill to compute-dense clusters and transferring KVCache over commodity Ethernet to local decode clusters, with bandwidth-aware scheduling and cache-aware placement.

results.title: SpectrumKV: Per-Token Mixed-Precision KV Cache Transfer for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
results.summary: Frames PD disaggregation as turning the KV cache into a network payload, and proposes a per-token mixed-precision scheme (FP16/INT8/INT4) to reduce the inter-node transfer burden between prefill and decode pools while preserving model quality.

results.title: Why Your Single-Node vLLM Setup Needs Prefill-Decode KV Connector
results.summary: Official vLLM post describing the prefill-decode (PD) KV cache transfer mechanism, where the prefill output KV cache is shipped from a prefill instance to a decode instance which is then notified, with practical guidance for single-node setups.

results.title: kvcache-ai/Mooncake (Transfer Engine for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation)
results.summary: Open-source Mooncake transfer engine repo; the Mooncake Transfer Engine is the KV cache transport backend for prefill-decode disaggregation and is officially supported as a NIXL backend plugin (May 2025) and by SGLang's EPD disaggregation.
